author: Times Radio
description:
A Sunday Times investigation has found England is in an overprescribing epidemic. Adverse reactions to cocktails of medicines are sending a thousand older people to A&E every day, potentially causing deaths, and costing the NHS billions. So how was this overlooked for so long? And can an already overstretched and underfunded NHS fix the problem?

This podcast was brought to you thanks to the support of readers of The Times and The Sunday Times. Subscribe today: http://thetimes.com/thestory

Guests:

John Lees, son-in-law of Joseph Darbyshire.
Shaun Lintern, health editor, The Sunday Times.
Professor Jugdeep Dhesi, consultant geriatrician at Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust.
Host: Manveen Rana.

Producer: Olivia Case.

We want to hear from you - email: thestory@thetimes.com
